Hi everyone, I'm Pierrick from Google Workspace. Today I'll show you how to connect and use Workspace connectors in Gemini Enterprise personal agents that are accessible from the web app. Let's assume you already created a new GCP project and configured billing. The first thing to do is to enable Gemini Enterprise: go to the console and search for Gemini Enterprise, select the product and click Start 30 days free trial to begin the onboarding process. You'll first need to activate the required API to enable the service for your project.

Часть коннекторов — из Google Workspace: Gmail, Calendar, Drive. Другие относятся к Google Cloud или к сторонним системам и обычно ходят в базы данных и API. Здесь выберем Google Drive. You can do a lot with this already. But what if you want your own custom agents to rely on data stores? In Gemini Enterprise, anyone can build their own personal agents using the agent designer. Это решение без кода. По умолчанию оно выключено, поэтому зайдите в настройки приложения и включите функцию. После этого вернёмся в веб-приложение Gemini Enterprise.
